candidates.hypothesis: Generate NRG;CALL FAR[bx] as the paint loop. Earning energy every two mandatory instructions can compensate its extra instruction and speed both paint/copy phases.
candidates.edits: Affected warrior sets destination low byte A0, seeds 9B9B FF1F, resets AX around two STOSW, changes DI adjustment to SUB3, copies 13 words; all moved worker and A zombie offsets rebased by labels. Unaffected warrior remains exact original.
candidates.failureModes: NRG-seeded cells are weaker lethal paint; bonuses change teammate/Zombie turn relation; larger worker is exposed two extra rounds and code overwrites become less regular.
